description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge, which is a filter component used within an HTML purifier library to modify or obfuscate URIs based on specific rules and configurations. It includes methods for preparing the filter with configuration data, filtering URIs, and creating replacements for URI components.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_Munge
classes.description: A URI filtering class that modifies URIs by replacing parts of them based on configuration settings, used in the HTML Purifier framework for secure and customizable URI handling.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration data, setting target URI, parser object, embedding options, and secret key.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Applies the URI filtering process, potentially modifying the URI based on embedding rules and host comparisons.

methods.name: makeReplace
methods.description: Generates replacement strings for URI components, considering the current context and optionally applying a secret-based hash.
